summary: Frontend-only testing of Zayado nav refactor (Kiabi-style header + mega-menu + drawer), marketplace search view, btn-gold color/pill shape and .field pill shape. All critical requirements verified on 1440x900 and 390x844. 42/47 raw asserts passed; the 5 'failures' were test-script bugs (curly apostrophe in 'l'entreprise', regex 9999 vs 999px) except for a minor data-testid naming discrepancy in footer (footer-minimal-link-cockpit instead of footer-link-cockpit). No console errors, no horizontal overflow, no amber/brown on CTAs.
action_items: Minor: review_request expected footer-link-cockpit; actual testid is footer-minimal-link-cockpit. Link exists and works. Either accept current naming or rename for consistency with the review spec.
critical_code_review_comments: All verified items pass visually and functionally. No critical issues found during this pass.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required behaviors working; only a testid naming discrepancy on footer-cockpit)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified items: (1) desktop header 1440 grid 3 cols — Menu + logo + search without overlap, main-row with Marketplace/Box/Services/Journal/La Maison. (2) Marketplace hover opens mega-menu with 8 real rays (mobilier/eclairage/vegetalisation/outils + bien-etre/concentration/outils/objet), 'Toute la marketplace' link, 'Pour l'entreprise' and 'Pour l'entrepreneur' universes (note: typographic apostrophe 'l’entreprise'), navy card 'Voir les box'. (3) Clicking Marketplace trigger navigates to /marketplace (no toggle issue). (4) Clicking mega-ray-mobilier navigates to /marketplace?q=Mobilier and renders 'Résultats pour « Mobilier »' with 1 product + marketplace-reset-search button. (5) Drawer opens full-height on both desktop (900px) and mobile (844px); contains all required links (cockpit, journal, maison, box, services, acquerir-une-entreprise, optimiser-mon-entreprise); overlay click closes; auto-closes on route change. (6) btn-gold CTAs are beige rgb(246,245,242) + 999px pill on tunnel-final-cta-diagnostic, maison-final-cta-diagnostic, journal-newsletter-submit, coming-soon-notify — no more amber/brown. (7) .field inputs are 999px pill on /coming-soon email and /journal search; textarea.field stays at 18px on /services. (8) No horizontal overflow on /, /maison, /journal, /marketplace, /tunnel/acquisition, /coming-soon in both 1440 and 390. (9) Footer contains Cockpit link (testid footer-minimal-link-cockpit, not footer-link-cockpit as specified in review request — minor naming mismatch, link still works). No console errors observed.
